description: FREE, no key. Companies House status check for a UK company: pass company_number (e.g. 00445790) for status, name, incorporation and cessation dates, registered office postcode and has_insolvency_history; or pass name for the top matches with their company numbers. Live Companies House data, cached up to 6 hours.

company_number.description: UK company number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456

name.description: Company name to search (returns top matches)

name: company_status
